current.text: He is not in the projected Rockets starting five. The projected starters are VanVleet, Thompson, Durant, Smith and Sengun.
Durant and Jabari Smith block his minutes. He projects for about 25 minutes and has no realistic path to 30 minutes unless Durant or Smith gets hurt.
More guard depth may push him into forward minutes only, which concentrates the frontcourt rotation.
The Rockets say they will cut Kevin Durant's minutes significantly. Lloyd does not believe it.
He is fine as a last-round pick.
He is Lloyd's stash option in formats that allow it. With 32 minutes while Durant or Smith is out, he would be about a top-70 player.
Late last season his three-point shooting collapsed, his blocks were cut in half and his steals dropped.
A bad three-point month dragged down his FG% last season, and it should improve.
With the March 28 end date, Houston has a weak 3-3-4 fantasy playoff schedule, 10 games over weeks 19 to 21.
Houston has only 14 back-to-backs this season.
Houston is projected to win 54 games and to play its regular season conservatively, without chasing seeding.

durable.text: He is a strong rebounder for a forward, and steals are his best category against the pool.
His assists are weak for his position.
The speaker has always been lower on him than consensus. He never believed Eason would become a starter, and says that has been basically correct.
Coach Ime Udoka is defense-first and plays his starters very heavy minutes, which leaves less room for bench players like Eason.

note: Both sites rank him outside the top 144 (Yahoo 159, ESPN 178) at 0 USD, and he cost 2 USD in our auction last season, so he is a 1 USD last-round pick at most. He fits punt AST builds that want rebounds and steals from a wing, and his upside depends on an injury to Durant or Jabari Smith. Early on, check whether his three-point shooting and FG% recover and whether Houston really cuts Durant's minutes. The weak 10-game playoff schedule makes him a weaker hold into March.
